level_patch.story: There is a second campus across the field. Its bays are empty and its data is not on this road.

callout.title: Two campuses, one road
callout.body: The far lot across the field is real capacity — but every vehicle's cargo lives on one campus or the other, and hauling it costs minutes per bay-hour. A vehicle parked away from its data pays for the trip on every second it runs.

callout.title: The trip you did not book
callout.body: That vehicle just started driving its own workload across the field — its run bar is longer than its promise by exactly the haul. The fix is not avoiding the far campus; it is choosing the trip ON PURPOSE when the far bays are what is free.

callout.title: The motorway gate
callout.body: The booth may now route: send a vehicle's whole drive to the campus of its data, or across the field when home is full — and the why-panel will show the trip it chose and the minutes it cost. Route deliberately and both campuses drain together.

callout.title: End of the week
callout.body: Both campuses busy, every trip on purpose. Next city is the whole board at once — everything you have learned, in one week.
